author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam is giddy as he sorts and cleans through hundreds of eyeglass lenses he recently picked up to make a complete Optician's lens set from the 1940s. With a vintage set like this, he's able to recreate any eyeglass prescription in a pinch by affixing lenses to a spectacular looking trial frame!

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
